sources.title: Alexander Kleshchev, Lectures on Infinite Dimensional Lie Algebras
sources.locator: Complete relevant arguments inspected in the 159-page PDF/text: Sections 6.1-6.4, printed pp.77-86; Section 9.2, pp.119-122; Sections 10.1-10.3, pp.127-134; Section 11.2, pp.153-154. The current PDF numbers formal characters as Section 9.2, not the design's Section 9.3.

contents.name: Section 9.2: formal character algebra and characters of category O modules
contents.support: Support in finitely many downward cones and coefficientwise-finite multiplication.

contents.name: Proposition 9.2.3: locally finite expansion in simple characters
contents.support: Finite truncation filtrations make the simple-character expansion coefficientwise meaningful.

contents.name: Lemma 9.2.4: PBW character of a Verma module
contents.support: Provides the unitriangular Verma/simple character system and product inverse.

contents.name: Proposition 9.2.5: Casimir-constrained Verma character expansion
contents.support: Integer coefficients, leading coefficient one, dominance bound, shifted-norm equality, and unitriangular inversion.

contents.name: Lemma 10.1.1: skew elements have alternating Weyl-orbit support
contents.support: Reduced-word descent, regularity, and coefficient signs in the formal completion.

contents.name: Lemma 10.1.2: dominant shifted-norm exclusion
contents.support: Dominance and invariant-form inequalities exclude a second dominant shifted weight.

contents.name: Theorem 10.2.1: Weyl-Kac character formula and denominator specialization
contents.support: Formal alternant numerator, actual root multiplicities, and the Lambda=0 denominator identity.

contents.name: Corollary 10.2.2: generalized Kostant multiplicity formula
contents.support: Coefficient extraction using the multiplicity-colored partition function.

contents.name: Section 10.3: affine A1 denominator and Jacobi triple product
contents.support: Separates the real and imaginary affine A1 factors with their correct index ranges.

contents.name: Sections 6.1-6.3: affine root systems and root multiplicities
contents.reason: The affine root-list and multiplicity theorem is a prerequisite interface owned by RL13; reproducing it inside the character-formula page would duplicate a substantial planned development.

contents.name: Section 6.4: affine Weyl group as translations and finite Weyl group
contents.reason: The translation-semidir-product calculation is needed by the basic affine character example and belongs to RL13, whose current canonical inventory is empty.

contents.name: Section 11.2: principally specialized basic affine characters
contents.support: Supports the finite low-degree expansion once the RL13 affine root and Weyl interfaces exist.

contents.name: Analytic convergence and modular-form interpretations of affine products
contents.locator: discussion following the formal identities in Sections 10.3 and 11.2
contents.reason: This page is explicitly confined to coefficientwise formal identities; analytic convergence regions and modular transformation laws require a separate analytic development.

sources.title: Nicolas Perrin, Introduction to Kac-Moody groups and Lie algebras
sources.locator: Complete relevant arguments inspected in the 279-page PDF/text: Section 10.7, printed pp.91-92; Sections 11.1-11.2, pp.93-99; Chapter 12 through Section 12.3, pp.101-110. Exact theorem locators include Lemma 11.2.4, Lemma 11.2.5 and Theorem 11.2.6.

contents.name: Section 10.7: formal character and Verma-module product
contents.support: Independent formal-series treatment and the PBW denominator inverse.

contents.name: Section 11.1: Casimir operator and scalar on highest-weight modules
contents.support: The present scaffold consumes the published Casimir interface and does not duplicate it.

contents.name: Lemma 11.2.4: shifted-norm Verma-character expansion
contents.support: Independent proof of the exact local lemma added before the denominator and numerator consumers.

contents.name: Lemma 11.2.5: Weyl-skew support and dominant representative
contents.support: Skewness, regular-orbit signs, and the dominant shifted-norm exclusion.

contents.name: Theorem 11.2.6: Weyl-Kac character and denominator formulas
contents.support: Second complete formula treatment; setting lambda=0 gives the denominator formula.

contents.name: Chapter 12 affine realization and root data
contents.reason: These affine realization, root-list and Weyl-group facts are genuine prerequisites for the requested affine factorization and examples, and are assigned to RL13 rather than this pair.

contents.name: Section 12.3: affine A1 denominator and triple product
contents.support: Independent affine A1 factorization with formal root variables.

contents.name: Kac-Moody group, flag-variety and later geometric chapters
contents.reason: The assigned pair concerns formal Lie-algebra characters; Kac-Moody group geometry and Schubert calculus do not enter any selected proof or example.
